plugins.description: Claude Code skills for product managers: explore many live UI variants on one board, pin feedback on exact elements, end with a written decision, pressure-test an idea, run a release go/no-go, hand a whole goal to sub-agents, cut clutter from a screen, and walk real people through a permissions or data model.
